description: This file defines the MessengerService class, an Android service that uses the Messenger class for inter-process communication (IPC). It manages client registration, unregistration, and updates a value shared with clients. It also handles displaying a notification while the service is running.

classes.name: MessengerService
classes.description: An Android Service that uses Messenger for IPC, managing client registration and messaging.

classes.name: MessengerService.IncomingHandler
classes.description: Handles incoming messages from clients, managing registration, unregistration, and value updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, including notification setup.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and cancels notifications when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder for clients to communicate with the service.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating the service is running.
